posts.title: Juggling multiple SSH_AUTH_SOCKs in tmux
posts.description: This post is about a portable Unix shell script, socklink.sh , written to keep SSH_AUTH_SOCK working within a long-running tmux session—even when switching between multiple clients that have different SSH agents, whether those clients are simultaneously connected or attaching and detaching over time.
